newsitem.title: USA: Essex County, N.J., Improvement 5.75 pct in 2026.
newsitem.headline: Essex County, N.J., Improvement 5.75 pct in 2026.

text.p: William E. Simon & Sons Municipal Securities said Thursday it priced and repriced a $5.8 million Essex County Improvement Authority, N.J., general obligation lease revenue bond issue, Series 1996A, for a county jail project, with a top yield of 5.75 percent in 2026.
The issue is MBIA insured and triple-A rated by Moody's Investors Service, Standard & Poor's Corp and Fitch Investors Service.
The bonds are dated 9/15 and due 12/1. The first coupon for the book-entry only bonds is 6/1/1997.
The verbal award has been received for the offering.
The bonds are callable Dec 1 2006 at 102.00, declining to par 2008.
